The code follows the project notes, including the short-line, short-function and import-order rules.

# owner: platform
import unittest

from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.contacts import format_contacts


def make_student(last, first, section, email):
    ident = last + first
    return Student(ident, last, first, section, email)


PAIR = [
    make_student("Young", "Al", "B", "al@x.org"),
    make_student("Abbott", "Beth", "A", "b@x.org")
]
EXPECTED = [
    "Abbott, Beth  A  b@x.org",
    "Young, Al     B  al@x.org"
]


class ContactTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rows_sorted_and_aligned(self):
        rows = format_contacts(PAIR)
        self.assertEqual(rows, EXPECTED)

    def test_same_last_name_sorts_by_first(self):
        rows = format_contacts([
            make_student("Lee", "Zed", "A", "z@x.org"),
            make_student("Lee", "Amy", "A", "a@x.org")
        ])
        self.assertTrue(rows[0].startswith("Lee, Amy"))

    def test_missing_email_names_student(self):
        pupil = make_student("Lee", "Amy", "A", None)
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError) as caught:
            format_contacts([pupil])
        self.assertIn("Lee, Amy", str(caught.exception))

    def test_blank_email_is_missing(self):
        pupil = make_student("Lee", "Amy", "A", "  ")
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            format_contacts([pupil])

    def test_empty_list_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            format_contacts([])
